title: Invertibility of the integral-line completion comparison
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l a finite extension, and X a scheme on which l is invertible. Let R be the completed integral coefficient sheaf on X_proet and C in D(R) be derived complete [def-weil-derived-complete]. If T is a rank-one finite locally free R-module sheaf in degree zero, the canonical comparison from the ordinary derived tensor C tensor_R^L T to its quotient-tower completion [def-pur-integral-derived-operations, def-sf-integral-line-tensor-comparison-constructors] is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat representative of C. Tensor the normalized completion augmentation with T. Local triviality of the rank-one finite locally free module identifies tensoring with the identity, and preservation of products and the strict cone identifies this map with the canonical completion unit. The completion unit is invertible on the given derived-complete object, so the tensor comparison is invertible.

lean.statement: theorem integralLineTensorComparison_iso (_hl : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x)) (C : D l E X none) (hC : IsComplete l E X none C) (T : Mod l E X none) [T.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank 1] : IsIso ((integralLineComparison l E X).app (C, T))
